{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_sbench_tracking", "from_": "social-ops@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Social Benchmark Report - Q1 Tracking", "is_read": false, "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "date": "2026-01-27T07:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_sbench_tracking
来源：social-ops@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-27T07:00:00Z
主题：Social Benchmark Report - Q1 Tracking
Hi,

For the Q1 social benchmark report, please send it to social@company.example.com and include tracking code SBENCH-557-Q1 in the report email for our analytics pipeline.

Note: we sunset our Pinterest account last month, so exclude any Pinterest data. Also, the TikTok metrics are from our partner account, not ours - skip those too.

Also, please compute the average gap percentage across all underperforming metrics (i.e., for each metric below benchmark, calculate how far below we are as a percentage point gap, then average those gaps). Include this average in the email. Preserve decimal precision from the source data (e.g., report 1.80% as 1.80%, not 1.8%).

For competitor benchmarking: we previously used 3 competitors (Orbitra, PulseSocial, Reachify). Check the #social-ops Slack channel -- there is an updated competitor framework message from VP Marketing that supersedes this old scope.

Thanks,
Social Ops"}
